english.title: Use a motor vehicle with closely spaced axles which exceeded the maximum permitted weight
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..),

(A)_[a wheeled motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[a wheeled trailer,]_
(C)_[an agricultural motor vehicle]_
(D)_[an agricultural trailer]_
(E)_[an agricultural trailed appliance]_

being a vehicle with two closely spaced axles to which regulation 79 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 applied when the total weight transmitted to the road surface by all the wheels of those axles exceeded the maximum permitted weight of **(..SPECIFY THE PERMITTED AXLE WEIGHT..) Kgs by **(..SPECIFY THE ACTUAL AXLE WEIGHT..) kg
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 79 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41B of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months
